controlRationale: PPO2 is predeclared before any stress outcomes: the v1 replica with positive map/count aggregates in its prior independent confirmation. No focal-control reselection on stress results; compare complete policies, not a causal component ablation.
strongPanel: All nonfocal seats use the exact retained reference on Germany and frozen expert24 on the other three maps. Reference remains Germany-only, all phases. Expert24 is stronger available opposition, not independent algorithmic diversity.
mixedPanel: Nonfocal ordinal=(seat-focalSeat+players)%players-1; i=cellIndex+deal+ordinal. Even i routes expert24; odd i routes weakPool[floor(i/2)%len(weakPool)]. Weak pool is ppo0,ppo1,ppo2,teacherV2, plus reference at the end on Germany only. Full seat rotations and identical assignments across focal policies. This deliberately varies strong-seat occupancy; it is not uniform sampling of every possible population.
seedRule: namespace[:smoke]:panel:cell:deal; independent roots between panels, identical within paired focal policies and seat rotations. No reuse of any historical training, diagnostic, confirmation or reserved-final roots.
routing: Expert24 learns only Auction/Building with unchanged v2 prior and fixed v2 Resources/Bureaucracy/forced moves. PPO0/1/2 use unchanged v1 learned phases, prior and fixed teacher. TeacherV2 controls all its phases. Reference controls all its own phases. No expert labels, optimization, sampling or checkpoint selection.
primaryAnalysis: For each panel separately, expert24 minus PPO2 paired focal win credit. Average all focal seats within each deal, then average four deals per fixed map/count/rule cell and weight all 80 cells equally. Use sample variance with ddof=1; SE=sqrt(sum_c(s_c^2/4))/80. Strong-panel within-cell roots share a lineup; mixed-panel lineup changes with deal, so s_c^2/4 includes between-lineup mean variation and is conservative in expectation, NOT an unbiased variance estimator for the fixed-schedule mean. Normal coverage remains approximate. Report normal 95% exploratory intervals and two-primary-comparison Bonferroni normal 97.5% intervals (z=2.241402727604947). No pooled population claim.
secondaryAnalysis: Per-map, player-count, rule, map-by-count and strong-opponent-occupancy subgroups; unadjusted exploratory intervals. Germany exact-reference neutral benchmark mean(1/n)=.29 is analytical, not a new played reference-control arm. Strong non-Germany all-expert24 focal games are deterministic all-seat symmetry/integrity controls, not strength evidence. Report reciprocal two-player outcomes. No endpoint or sample-size changes after results.
precision: Four fresh deals per cell is a bounded diagnostic budget, not a promised confidence width or qualification sample. Report achieved precision. Do not extend based on significance; any later extension needs a separately frozen protocol and fresh roots.
nextDecision: Consider independent training replicas only if both panel primary Bonferroni interval lower bounds exceed zero and no per-map/panel paired point estimate is below -.05. Otherwise diagnose the fixed stress evidence before any new learning recipe. This is a research progression heuristic, not qualification or a statistical guarantee over all subgroup comparisons.
storage: No models or raw states/actions/trajectories in study output. At most 320 atomic paired all-seat deal-batch JSON files per panel plus plan/summary; 64 MiB guard. Save each completed batch locally and publish every 16 batches. Immutable source/runtime/full-task resume never repeats remotely checkpointed batches. A killed ephemeral job may lose up to 15 locally completed batches plus its interrupted batch; all work since the last remote checkpoint may replay with identical tasks, counted once. Any game error aborts the run; no fabricated losses or silent game retries.
execution: Two independently resumable private cpu-upgrade jobs, one per panel, six collector workers each, three-hour cap each. Source archive and selected weights identical. Results interpreted only after both panels finish and integrity checks pass.
